input.summary: Add renewal mechanic for the maintenance term: automatic 12-month renewals, 30-day Sparkling opt-out, 60-day Garman reminder, uplift capped at lesser of CPI and 3%.
input.comment: [Playbook] The maintenance term is described only as "renewable", with no renewal mechanic, exit window or price protection, so we added automatic twelve-month renewals that Sparkling may exit on thirty (30) days' notice, a sixty (60) day renewal reminder from Garman and a cap on maintenance fee increases at the lesser of CPI and 3%. We can accept a fallback of a sixty (60) day non-renewal window with increases capped at 5%.

ops.text: The maintenance term shall renew automatically for successive renewal terms of twelve (12) months each, unless Sparkling gives Garman written notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days before the end of the then-current term. Garman shall remind Sparkling of the upcoming renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current term. Maintenance fees for any renewal term shall not increase by more than the lesser of the increase in the Consumer Price Index during the then-current term and three percent (3%).
